mapper.sql: select i.id, i.material_id, i.quantity, i.avg_price, i.update_time, m.material_no, m.material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.safety_stock from biz_inventory i left join biz_material m on m.material_id = i.material_id
mapper.select:
AND i.material_id = #{materialId} AND m.material_no like concat('%', #{materialNo}, '%') AND m.material_name like concat('%', #{materialName}, '%') AND m.spec like concat('%', #{spec}, '%')
order by i.material_id
where m.status = '0' and i.quantity <= m.safety_stock order by i.quantity
mapper.insert: insert into biz_inventory (material_id, quantity, avg_price, update_time) values (#{materialId}, #{quantity}, #{avgPrice}, sysdate())
